subject: Quantiply renewal: annualized hosted capacity + tiered rate proposal
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@quantiply.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@quantiply.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal discussion — hosted API commit increase

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from Quantiply: our usage has grown ~3.8x year-over-year and the current hosted monthly commit is hitting regular soft-throttle windows. We’re planning to renew in December and want to convert to an annualized higher-commit plan to avoid throttles and reduce unit cost.

High-level asks:
- Options for a 3–5x uplift on committed monthly tokens and the unit-rate impact for each tier.
- How burst pockets/soft-throttle behave when the account is on a larger annual commit.
- Any onboarding or provisioning lead time (we need this live by Jan 10).
- Standard paperwork cadence: will you accept an emailed PO + SOW and net-30 invoice?

We can share a PO once we land on numbers. Would appreciate a simple pricing comparison (current vs two upgrade paths) and any recommended guardrails we should set to preserve latency SLOs.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform
Quantiply

---
Attachment: none (PO will follow)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@quantiply.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@quantiply.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — hosted API commit increase

Thanks Olivia — great to hear usage is expanding. Congrats on the growth. Below is a concise proposal and next steps so your procurement team can move fast.

Summary (two upgrade paths):
1) Annualized Tier A — 3x monthly commit (annual prepay):
   - Commit: 3x current monthly tokens
   - Unit rate: $0.0016 / gen-token (6% discount vs current)
   - Burst pocket: 15% of monthly commit available per month; soft-throttle applies only after burst is exhausted
   - Lead time: provisioned within 7 business days after PO + signed SOW
2) Annualized Tier B — 5x monthly commit (annual prepay + 12-month SLA):
   - Commit: 5x current monthly tokens
   - Unit rate: $0.0014 / gen-token (14% discount vs current)
   - Burst pocket: 25% monthly; automatic fallback to nearby region if capacity constrained (no functional changes required from your side)
   - Lead time: provisioned within 10 business days after PO + signed SOW

Notes / recommendations:
- We recommend Tier B if you want to avoid most throttles and capture the best unit economics.
- We can configure per-route soft-throttle thresholds so your real-time features maintain strict latency SLOs while batch jobs consume burst.
- If procurement needs a PO-first flow, we accept emailed PO + attached SOW, Redwood billing will issue net-30 invoices.

I’ve attached Proposal_v3.pdf with a one-page comparison table and the draft SOW (Quantiply_SOW-Nov2026.xlsx). If these look good, send the PO and we’ll loop finance for invoicing.

Next step options:
- Quick sync (15–20m) this week to walk pricing and SLAs
- You send a PO and we initiate provisioning checklist

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
